name: Harbor Over-Ear Headphones
description: Closed-back cans tuned for long listening sessions. The clamp is gentle, the pads breathe, and the cable detaches when you inevitably step on it.

name: Drift Wireless Earbuds
description: Small, light, and mostly invisible. Battery lasts a full workday with ANC on; longer with it off.

name: Stoneworks Bookshelf Speakers
description: Two-way bookshelf pair with a soft-dome tweeter. Pair them with a small amp and a corner of the room you like.

name: Field Portable DAC
description: USB-C in, balanced 4.4mm out. For laptops that forgot how to do audio.

name: Lowtide Vinyl Turntable
description: Belt-drive, manual operation, pre-mounted cartridge so you can play a record within five minutes of opening the box. Built-in phono stage you can switch off when you grow out of it.

name: Loft Portable Speaker
description: Pocket-bag-sized. IP67. Honest about its bass.

name: Ember Ceramic Mug Set
description: Four mugs, hand-finished, no two glazes identical. Holds 350ml, dishwasher fine if you must.

name: Linen Throw Blanket
description: Stonewashed Belgian linen. Heavier than it looks. Gets softer every wash.

name: Walnut Cutting Board
description: End-grain walnut, 18 by 12 inches, finished with food-safe oil. Resharpens your knives slightly slower than a plastic one ruins them.

name: Halo Desk Lamp
description: Warm 2700K LED, stepless dimming, a single brass knob. No app, no firmware, nothing to update.

name: Shoji Paper Lantern
description: Hand-folded washi over a beech frame. Ships flat; assembles in about a minute.

name: Ridge 32L Daypack
description: One main compartment, one laptop sleeve, no extra zippers to break. Recycled 420D nylon, YKK hardware.

name: Alpine Titanium Cookpot
description: 750ml. 132 grams. Folds its own handle.

name: Salt Flat Sunglasses
description: Polarized, glass lenses, acetate frame. Heavier than the plastic ones; that is the point.

name: Campline Tent 2P
description: Double-wall, freestanding, 2.1kg packed. Two doors, two vestibules, room for one person and a dog or two people who like each other a lot.

name: Trailwarden Headlamp
description: USB-C rechargeable. 400 lumens on high, 12 hours on low, red mode for not-blinding-your-tentmate.

name: Kabuto Leather Wallet
description: Bifold, six card slots, full-grain veg-tan that starts pale and earns a patina over a year or two.

name: Monolith Mechanical Watch
description: 38mm case, Swiss automatic movement, sapphire crystal. Loses about four seconds a day. Don't wear it diving.

name: Raw Canvas Belt
description: One strap, one buckle, one length you cut to fit. Hard to ruin.

name: Merino Watch Cap
description: Single-ply merino, no itch, no logo. Three colors that all look the same in low light.
